thread:
maya: Quick sync — I pushed a PR for the new Tone Ladder + Terminology primer: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/781. Main asks: 1) settle on short vs long names for Dedicated/Private in copy & SDK snippets, 2) agree on voice guidelines (friendly vs formal), 3) confirm glossary entries and redirects. Can folks skim today?

alex: Skimming now. My immediate thought: use the short name in product-facing copy (e.g., UI labels) and the long descriptive name in first-occurrence docs (e.g., 'Dedicated (Reserved GPU capacity)'). That keeps UX concise but docs precise.

priya: +1 on short in UI. For tutorials and quickstarts we should bias toward short names to reduce cognitive load. But DevRel wants a single canonical glossary term to map aliases. Can we add a "aliases" field in the glossary? e.g., "Dedicated": ["Dedicated Capacity", "Reserved GPU pool"].

emily: I prototyped that in the PR — added alias list and a redirect page. Also added suggested microcopy for headings and a short "tone ladder" with examples: "Direct & helpful" vs "Formal/legal". Example copy: "Use: 'Start a Dedicated instance' (not 'start dedicated capacity')".

chris: For product-led pages we should keep verbs active and time-to-value oriented. Eg "Get started with Dedicated" vs "Provision Dedicated Capacity". Which do we pick for SDK samples? Lower friction wins.

maya: Good debate. For SDK snippets we should show the simplest form devs can copy-paste. If the SDK surface uses model names or parameters that rely on the longer term, add a parenthetical comment.

emily: Proposed Python snippet for the streaming chat example — please review format and naming (used 'Dedicated' in comments):

```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY")

# Connect to a model hosted on Dedicated
for chunk in client.chat.stream(model="rwd-7b-dedicated", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize quarterly goals."}]):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

alex: Snippet looks good. Minor nit: use snake_case for local vars per our style guide — maybe `redwood_client` vs `client`. Also recommend showing context for `model` naming in a one-line comment: `# model: rwd-7b-dedicated (Dedicated deployment)`

priya: Also, add a small footnote about retries/backoff for Dedicated endpoints — customers often hit transient capacity errors. A one-liner link to the retry policy should suffice.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #781 — docs lint OK, spellcheck OK.

emily: Updated snippet with comments and replaced `client` -> `redwood_client`. Added footnote line linking to retry guide. Pushed a small follow-up commit.

maya: Action items from thread: 1) finalize glossary alias list + redirects (emily + priyA?) 2) update tone ladder bullets and short examples (emily) 3) confirm SDK snippet naming + one-line model comment (alex) 4) add retry/backoff footnote and link (priya). I'll batch these into PR #781 and ask for final reviews by EOD.

alex: I can take the SDK naming check.

priya: I'll draft the footnote and the retry link.

emily: I'll land the alias structure and tone ladder edits, then tag you both for final.

chris: One more thought on voice: avoid marketing superlatives in procedural docs (no "best-in-class"). Use measurable claims only in benchmarks page.

maya: Noted. Thanks everyone — ping me if you need more context. I'll update the PR description with the decision summary before merging. :rocket:
